title: Meal Planning on a Changing Schedule · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Lin is a busy nurse in Shanghai. Her work schedule changes every week. Some weeks she works early shifts, and some weeks she works late shifts. Because of this, Lin plans her meals carefully. She does not want to eat too much fast food. She knows she should eat more vegetables and fruit. On Sunday evening, Lin sits down with her notebook. She writes a meal plan for the week. She checks how many days she works and how much time she has for cooking. She has a few recipes for quick meals. She also has a little time on Wednesday to go to the market. She should buy some eggs, tomatoes, and rice. She should not buy too many snacks because she eats them too quickly. Lin also thinks about her drinks. She drinks a lot of water, but she drinks too much coffee on late shifts. She should drink less coffee and more water.
